title: Rama sends Angada to Ravana
introduction: Rama advises Sugreeva not to repeat such reckless acts in future on the ground of he being a king. Then Rama tells Lakshmana about the various evil portents he had seen. Rama commands the monkey-generals to besiege all the four gates of Lanka. He himself along with Lakshmana protects the army, besieging the northern gate being guarded by Ravana. Then, Rama sends Angada to Ravana, to expostulate him and to bring him back to reason. Angada tries his best to convince Ravana, but in vain. Ravana commands his attendants to seize Angada. Angada shakes out those attendants who tried to seize him ascends the roof of Ravana's palace, tramples ad crushes it down by his strength. Angada finally returns to Rama, who was stationed in the midst of the monkey-forces.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे एकचत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 41st Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
अथ तस्मिन् निमित्तानि दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मण पूर्वजः |
सुग्रीवम् सम्परिष्वज्य रामो वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
atha tasmin nimittāni dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇa pūrvajaḥ |
sugrīvam sampariṣvajya rāmo vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: Seeing the marks of conflict on the person of Sugreeva, Rama the elder brother of Lakshmana after embracing Sugreeva spoke these words.

verses.devanagari:
असंमन्त्य्र मया सार्थम् तदिदम् साहसं कृतम् |
एवम् साहसयुक्तानि न कुर्वन्ति जनेश्वराः
verses.iast:
asaṃmantyra mayā sārtham tadidam sāhasaṃ kṛtam |
evam sāhasayuktāni na kurvanti janeśvarāḥ
verses.translation: "Without consulting me closely, such a reckless act has been done by you, such a rashness is not seemly in a king."

verses.devanagari:
संशये स्थाप्य माम् चेदम् बलम् चेमम् विभीषनम् |
कष्टं कृतमिदं वीर साहसं साहसप्रिय
verses.iast:
saṃśaye sthāpya mām cedam balam cemam vibhīṣanam |
kaṣṭaṃ kṛtamidaṃ vīra sāhasaṃ sāhasapriya
verses.translation: "O, warrior longing for acts of daring! This wrong and reckless act has been done by you, causing me, this army and Vibhishana great anxiety."

verses.devanagari:
इदानीं मा कृथा वीर एवम् विधमरिंदम |
त्वयि किंचित्समापन्ने किम् कार्यम् सीतया मम
भरतेन महाबाहो लक्ष्मणेन यवीयसा |
शत्रुघ्नेन च शत्रुघ्न स्वशरीरेण वा पुनः
verses.iast:
idānīṃ mā kṛthā vīra evam vidhamariṃdama |
tvayi kiṃcitsamāpanne kim kāryam sītayā mama
bharatena mahābāho lakṣmaṇena yavīyasā |
śatrughnena ca śatrughna svaśarīreṇa vā punaḥ
verses.translation: "O, warrior! O, vanquisher of foes! Do not act thus in future. O, the mighty armed! O, annihilator of enemies! If you have come by some misfortune, I would have had nothing to do with Seetha, Bharata, Lakshmana or still younger Shatrughna or even with my own person."

glosses.meaning: or even with my own person?

verses.devanagari:
त्वयि चानागते पूर्वमिति मे निश्चिता मतिः |
जानतश्चापि ते वीर्यम् महेन्द्रवरुणोपनु
हत्वाहम् रावणम् रावणम् युद्धे सपुत्रबलवाहन्म् |
अभिषिच्य च लङ्कायाम् विभीषण मथापि च
भरते राज्यमारोप्य त्यक्ष्ये देहम् महाबल |
verses.iast:
tvayi cānāgate pūrvamiti me niścitā matiḥ |
jānataścāpi te vīryam mahendravaruṇopanu
hatvāham rāvaṇam rāvaṇam yuddhe saputrabalavāhanm |
abhiṣicya ca laṇ^kāyām vibhīṣaṇa mathāpi ca
bharate rājyamāropya tyakṣye deham mahābala |
verses.translation: "O, monkey of great strength, equal to Indra the god of celestials and Varuna the king of universe! If you have not returned, though I am conversant with your valour, this was my pre-determined resolve that having killed Ravana in fight with his sons forces and chariots, I should have installed Vibhishana as king of Lanka, placing the kingdom of Ayodhya in the hands of Bharata and renounced my life."

glosses.meaning: equal to Indra the god of celestials and Varuna king of the Universe!
with his sons forces and chariots

verses.devanagari:
तमेवम्वादिनं रामं सुग्रीवः प्रत्यभाषत
तव भार्यापहर्तारं दृष्ट्वा राघव रावणम् |
मर्षयामि कथम् वीर जानन्विक्रममात्मनः
verses.iast:
tamevamvādinaṃ rāmaṃ sugrīvaḥ pratyabhāṣata
tava bhāryāpahartāraṃ dṛṣṭvā rāghava rāvaṇam |
marṣayāmi katham vīra jānanvikramamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing Rama's words, Sugreeva replied as follows: "O, brave Rama! Seeing Ravana who had taken away your consort and being conscious of my own strength, how can I act otherwise?"

glosses.meaning: who had taken away your consort

verses.devanagari:
इत्येवंवादिनं वीरमभिनन्द्य च राघवः |
लक्ष्मणम् लक्ष्मि सम्पन्नम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
ityevaṃvādinaṃ vīramabhinandya ca rāghavaḥ |
lakṣmaṇam lakṣmi sampannam idam vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Complimenting that hero Sugreeva who was thus speaking, Rama addressed Lakshmana, who was endowed with auspicious marks, saying:

glosses.meaning: who was thus speaking raaghavaH = Rama
was was endowed with auspicious marks.

verses.devanagari:
परिगृह्य उदकम् शीतम् वनानि फलवन्ति च |
बल ओघम् सम्विभज्य इमम् व्यूह्य तिष्ठेम लक्ष्मण
verses.iast:
parigṛhya udakam śītam vanāni phalavanti ca |
bala ogham samvibhajya imam vyūhya tiṣṭhema lakṣmaṇa
verses.translation: "O, Lakshmana! Beside these fresh waters and trees laden with fruit, let us divide this multitude of troops, drawing it up in a battle array and remain alert."

glosses.meaning: and drawing it up in a battle array

verses.devanagari:
लोक क्षय करम् भीमम् भयम् पश्याम्य् उपस्थितम् |
निबर्हणम् प्रवीराणाम् ऋक्ष वानर रक्षसाम्
verses.iast:
loka kṣaya karam bhīmam bhayam paśyāmy upasthitam |
nibarhaṇam pravīrāṇām ṛkṣa vānara rakṣasām
verses.translation: "I foresee a terrible calamity to come, boding universal destruction and death to the intrepid bears, monkeys and demons."

verses.devanagari:
वाताश् च परुषम् वान्ति कम्पते च वसुम् धरा |
पर्वत अग्राणि वेपन्ते पतन्ति धरणी धराः
verses.iast:
vātāś ca paruṣam vānti kampate ca vasum dharā |
parvata agrāṇi vepante patanti dharaṇī dharāḥ
verses.translation: "Harsh winds blow. The earth trembles. Mountain-peaks shake and the elephants bearing the earth trumpet."

glosses.meaning: and the elephants bearing the earth

verses.devanagari:
मेघाः क्रव्याद सम्काशाह् परुषाह् परुष स्वनाः |
क्रूराह् क्रूरम् प्रवर्षन्ति मिश्रम् शोणित बिन्दुभिः
verses.iast:
meghāḥ kravyāda samkāśāh paruṣāh paruṣa svanāḥ |
krūrāh krūram pravarṣanti miśram śoṇita bindubhiḥ
verses.translation: "Sinister clouds prey-roar violently like carnivorous animals and let fall a rain mixed with drops of blood."

verses.devanagari:
रक्त चन्दन सम्काशा संध्या परम दारुणा |
ज्वलच् च निपतत्य् एतद् आदित्याद् अग्नि मण्डलम्
verses.iast:
rakta candana samkāśā saṃdhyā parama dāruṇā |
jvalac ca nipataty etad ādityād agni maṇḍalam
verses.translation: "The dusk, red as sandal, is full of horror and from the sun, this blazing mass of fire falls."

verses.devanagari:
आदित्यम् अभि वाश्यन्ते जनयन्तो महद् भयम् |
दीना दीन स्वरा घोरा;अप्रशस्ता मृग द्विजाः
verses.iast:
ādityam abhi vāśyante janayanto mahad bhayam |
dīnā dīna svarā ghorā;apraśastā mṛga dvijāḥ
verses.translation: "Wile beasts and birds emit frantic cries, ill at ease and ominous, inspiring great fear, facing the sun."

verses.devanagari:
रजन्याम् अप्रकाशश् च सम्तापयति चन्द्रमाः |
कृष्ण रक्त अंशु पर्यन्तो यथा लोकस्य सम्क्षये
verses.iast:
rajanyām aprakāśaś ca samtāpayati candramāḥ |
kṛṣṇa rakta aṃśu paryanto yathā lokasya samkṣaye
verses.translation: "The moon shorn of its radiance, surrounded by black and fiery rays, burns red as at the time of destruction of the word and is creating an anguish in the night."

glosses.meaning: surrounded by black and fiery rays
as at the time of the destraction of the world

verses.devanagari:
ह्रस्वो रूक्षो अप्रशस्तश् च परिवेषह् सुलोहितः |
आदित्य मण्डले नीलम् लक्ष्म लक्ष्मण दृश्यते
verses.iast:
hrasvo rūkṣo apraśastaś ca pariveṣah sulohitaḥ |
āditya maṇḍale nīlam lakṣma lakṣmaṇa dṛśyate
verses.translation: "O, Lakshmana! In the disk of the sun, a small halo with a black mark, fiery, shorn of its radiance and of coppery hue is seen."

glosses.meaning: In the disk of the sun

verses.devanagari:
दृश्यन्ते न यथावच् च नक्षत्राण्य् अभिवर्तते |
युग अन्तम् इव लोकस्य पश्य लक्ष्मण शंसति
verses.iast:
dṛśyante na yathāvac ca nakṣatrāṇy abhivartate |
yuga antam iva lokasya paśya lakṣmaṇa śaṃsati
verses.translation: "O, Lakshmana! The stars are not appearing as they should be duly foretelling their intention to hasten a final dissolution of the world."

verses.devanagari:
काकाः श्येनास् तथा गृध्रा नीचैह् परिपतन्ति च |
शिवाश् च अप्य् अशिवा वाचह् प्रवदन्ति महा स्वनाः
verses.iast:
kākāḥ śyenās tathā gṛdhrā nīcaih paripatanti ca |
śivāś ca apy aśivā vācah pravadanti mahā svanāḥ
verses.translation: "Crows, eagles and vultures are whirling round at a lower level. Jackals too are howling inauspicious sounds."

verses.devanagari:
शैलैः शूलैश्च खड्गैश्च विमुक्तेः कपिराक्षसैः |
भविष्यत्यावृता भूमिर्मांसशोणितकर्दमा
verses.iast:
śailaiḥ śūlaiśca khaḍgaiśca vimukteḥ kapirākṣasaiḥ |
bhaviṣyatyāvṛtā bhūmirmāṃsaśoṇitakardamā
verses.translation: "The earth, crowded with rocks, darts and daggers discharged by monkeys and demons, will become a slime of flesh and blood."

glosses.meaning: a slime of flesh and blood.

verses.devanagari:
क्षिप्रम् अद्य दुराधर्षाम् पुरीम् रावण पालिताम् |
अभियाम जवेन एव सर्वतो हरिभिर् वृताः
verses.iast:
kṣipram adya durādharṣām purīm rāvaṇa pālitām |
abhiyāma javena eva sarvato haribhir vṛtāḥ
verses.translation: "Now surrounded by the monkeys from all sides, let us make an attack on that invincible citadel ruled by Ravana quickly and swiftly."

verses.devanagari:
इत्य् एवम् तु वदन् वीरो लक्ष्मणम् लक्ष्मण अग्रजः |
तस्माद् अवातरत् शीघ्रम् पर्वत अग्रान् महा बलः
verses.iast:
ity evam tu vadan vīro lakṣmaṇam lakṣmaṇa agrajaḥ |
tasmād avātarat śīghram parvata agrān mahā balaḥ
verses.translation: Thus speaking to Lakshmana, the heroic Rama of great strength climbed down from that mountain-peak.

verses.devanagari:
अवतीर्य तु धर्म आत्मा तस्मात् शैलात् स राघवः |
परैः परम दुर्धर्षम् ददर्श बलम् आत्मनः
verses.iast:
avatīrya tu dharma ātmā tasmāt śailāt sa rāghavaḥ |
paraiḥ parama durdharṣam dadarśa balam ātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Having descended from that mountain, Rama, whose mind was set on righeousness, held a review of his own army, which was verily difficult to conquer for the enemies.

verses.devanagari:
सम्नह्य तु ससुग्रीवह् कपि राज बलम् महत् |
कालज्नो राघवह् काले सम्युगाय अभ्यचोदयत्
verses.iast:
samnahya tu sasugrīvah kapi rāja balam mahat |
kālajno rāghavah kāle samyugāya abhyacodayat
verses.translation: Rama, who knew the fitting moment to act, along with Sugreeva made ready the great army and commanded the army to advance, at the appropriate moment for the battle.

verses.devanagari:
ततः काले महा बाहुर् बलेन महता वृतः |
प्रस्थितह् पुरतो धन्वी लन्काम् अभिमुखह् पुरीम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ kāle mahā bāhur balena mahatā vṛtaḥ |
prasthitah purato dhanvī lankām abhimukhah purīm
verses.translation: Rama, the mighty armed, together with the mighty army marched in front, wielding a bow, towards the city of Lanka, at the befitting moment.

verses.devanagari:
तम् विभीषण सुग्रीवौ हनूमान् जाम्बवान् नलः |
ऋक्ष राजस् तथा नीलो लक्ष्मणश् च अन्ययुस् तदा
verses.iast:
tam vibhīṣaṇa sugrīvau hanūmān jāmbavān nalaḥ |
ṛkṣa rājas tathā nīlo lakṣmaṇaś ca anyayus tadā
verses.translation: Then, Vibhishana, Sugreeva, Hanuman, Jambavan the king of bears, Nala, Nila and Lakshmana accompanied that Rama.

verses.devanagari:
ततः पश्चात् सुमहती पृतना ऋक्ष वन ओकसाम् |
प्रच्चाद्य महतीम् भूमिम् अनुयाति स्म राघवम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ paścāt sumahatī pṛtanā ṛkṣa vana okasām |
praccādya mahatīm bhūmim anuyāti sma rāghavam
verses.translation: Thereafter, fully covering a vast stretch of land, the great army of bears and monkeys, followed in the wake of Rama.

verses.devanagari:
शैल शृन्गाणि शतशह् प्रवृद्धांश् च मही रुहाम् |
जगृहुह् कुन्जर प्रख्या वानराह् पर वारणाः
verses.iast:
śaila śṛngāṇi śataśah pravṛddhāṃś ca mahī ruhām |
jagṛhuh kunjara prakhyā vānarāh para vāraṇāḥ
verses.translation: Monkeys, the annihilator of enemies, resembling elephants, took hold of mountain-peaks and hundreds of well-grown huge trees.

verses.devanagari:
तौ त्व् अदीर्घेण कालेन भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ |
रावणस्य पुरीम् लन्काम् आसेदतुर् अरिम् दमौ
verses.iast:
tau tv adīrgheṇa kālena bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau |
rāvaṇasya purīm lankām āsedatur arim damau
verses.translation: Those two brothers Rama and Lakshmana, the destroyers of their adversaries, reached the city of Lanka ruled by Ravana, in not a long time.

verses.devanagari:
पताका मालिनीम् रम्याम् उद्यान वन शोभिताम् |
चित्र वप्राम् सुदुष्प्रापाम् उच्च प्राकार तोरणाम्
ताम् सुरैर् अपि दुर्धर्षाम् राम वाक्य प्रचोदिताः |
यथा निदेशम् सम्पीड्य न्यविशन्त वन ओकसः
verses.iast:
patākā mālinīm ramyām udyāna vana śobhitām |
citra vaprām suduṣprāpām ucca prākāra toraṇām
tām surair api durdharṣām rāma vākya pracoditāḥ |
yathā nideśam sampīḍya nyaviśanta vana okasaḥ
verses.translation: The monkeys, encouraged by the sound of Rama's voice and obedient to his command, halted before the city of Lanka, garlanded with banners, beautiful and splendid with pleasure-gardens, having an unusual rampart which is inaccessible with its elevated arched door-ways and invincible even by the celestials.

glosses.meaning: encouraged by the sound of Rama's voice (and)

verses.devanagari:
लन्कायास् तु उत्तर द्वारम् शैल शृन्गम् इव उन्नतम् |
रामः सह अनुजो धन्वी जुगोप च रुरोध च
लन्काम् उपनिविष्टश् च रामो दशरथ आत्मजः |
लक्ष्मण अनुचरो वीरह् पुरीम् रावण पालिताम्
उत्तर द्वारम् आसाद्य यत्र तिष्ठति रावणः |
न अन्यो रामाद्द् हि तद् द्वारम् समर्थह् परिरक्षितुम्
रावण अधिष्ठितम् भीमम् वरुणेन इव सागरम् |
सायुधौ राक्षसैर् भीमैर् अभिगुप्तम् समन्ततः
लघूनाम् त्रास जननम् पातालम् इव दानवैः |
verses.iast:
lankāyās tu uttara dvāram śaila śṛngam iva unnatam |
rāmaḥ saha anujo dhanvī jugopa ca rurodha ca
lankām upaniviṣṭaś ca rāmo daśaratha ātmajaḥ |
lakṣmaṇa anucaro vīrah purīm rāvaṇa pālitām
uttara dvāram āsādya yatra tiṣṭhati rāvaṇaḥ |
na anyo rāmādd hi tad dvāram samarthah parirakṣitum
rāvaṇa adhiṣṭhitam bhīmam varuṇena iva sāgaram |
sāyudhau rākṣasair bhīmair abhiguptam samantataḥ
laghūnām trāsa jananam pātālam iva dānavaiḥ |
verses.translation: Reaching the city of Lanka ruled by Ravana, the heroic Rama the son of Dasaratha accompanied by Lakshmana, halted near the northern gate, where Ravana stayed. Who else but Rama is capable of protecting the army besieging that gate, regulated by Ravana, as an ocean, regulated by Varuna, guarded by awful demons on all sides and creating fear to the weak as a subterranean region is guarded by demons?

verses.devanagari:
विन्यस्तानि च योधानाम् बहूनि विविधानि च |
ददर्श आयुध जालानि तथैव कवचानि च
verses.iast:
vinyastāni ca yodhānām bahūni vividhāni ca |
dadarśa āyudha jālāni tathaiva kavacāni ca
verses.translation: Rama saw various types and multitude of weapons and shields kept there by the warriors.

verses.devanagari:
पूर्वम् तु द्वारम् आसाद्य नीलो हरि चमू पतिः |
अतिष्ठत् सह मैन्देन द्विविदेन च वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
pūrvam tu dvāram āsādya nīlo hari camū patiḥ |
atiṣṭhat saha maindena dvividena ca vīryavān
verses.translation: Nila, the valiant army-chief of monkeys together with Mainda and Dvivida reached and halted before the Eastern gate.

verses.devanagari:
अन्गदो दक्षिण द्वारम् जग्राह सुमहा बलः |
ऱ्षभेण गव अक्षेण गजेन गवयेन च
verses.iast:
angado dakṣiṇa dvāram jagrāha sumahā balaḥ |
Rṣabheṇa gava akṣeṇa gajena gavayena ca
verses.translation: Angada of very mighty prowess, together with Rishhabha, Gavaksha, Gaja and Gavaya took charge of the Southern gate.

verses.devanagari:
हनूमान् पश्चिम द्वारम् ररक्ष बलवान् कपिः |
प्रमाथि प्रघसाभ्याम् च वीरैर् अन्यैश् च सम्गतः
verses.iast:
hanūmān paścima dvāram rarakṣa balavān kapiḥ |
pramāthi praghasābhyām ca vīrair anyaiś ca samgataḥ
verses.translation: The strong monkey Hanuman together with Prajangha, Tarasa and other warriors, guarded the western gate.

verses.devanagari:
मध्यमे च स्वयम् गुल्मे सुग्रीवह् समतिष्ठत |
सह सर्वैर् हरि श्रेष्ठैह् सुपर्ण श्वसन उपमैः
verses.iast:
madhyame ca svayam gulme sugrīvah samatiṣṭhata |
saha sarvair hari śreṣṭhaih suparṇa śvasana upamaiḥ
verses.translation: Sugreeva, along with all the chiefs of monkeys equal to the strength of Garuda (the eagle and the vehicle of Vishnu) as well as Vayu the god of the wind, was stationed himself in the middle of the fort.

glosses.meaning: equal to Garuda the eagle and the vehicle of Vishnu and Vayu the god of the wind
stationed svayam- himself madhyame = in the middle

verses.devanagari:
वानराणाम् तु षट् त्रिंशत् कोट्यह् प्रख्यात यूथपाः
निपीड्य उपनिविष्टाश् च सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः |
verses.iast:
vānarāṇām tu ṣaṭ triṃśat koṭyah prakhyāta yūthapāḥ
nipīḍya upaniviṣṭāś ca sugrīvo yatra vānaraḥ |
verses.translation: Thirty six crores of monkeys, highly renowned generals stood besiezed, where the monkey Sugreeva was there, having exerted pressure on the demons occupying that post.

glosses.meaning: having exerted pressure (on the demons occupying that post).

verses.devanagari:
शासनेन तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणह् सविभीषणः
द्वारे द्वारे हरीणाम् तु कोटिम् कोटिम् न्यवेशयत् |
verses.iast:
śāsanena tu rāmasya lakṣmaṇah savibhīṣaṇaḥ
dvāre dvāre harīṇām tu koṭim koṭim nyaveśayat |
verses.translation: Meanwhile, under Rama's command, Lakshmana along with Vibhishana distributed a crore each of his monkeys at each gate.

verses.devanagari:
पश्चिमेन तु रामस्य सुग्रीवह् सह जाम्बवान्
अदूरान् मध्यमे गुल्मे तस्थौ बहु बल अनुगः |
verses.iast:
paścimena tu rāmasya sugrīvah saha jāmbavān
adūrān madhyame gulme tasthau bahu bala anugaḥ |
verses.translation: Behind Rama and not far from him, Sushena together with Jambavan, followed by a multitude of forces, stood at the intermediate post.

glosses.meaning: followed by a multitude of forces

verses.devanagari:
ते तु वानर शार्दूलाह् शार्दूला;इव दम्ष्ट्रिणः
गृहीत्वा द्रुम शैल अग्रान् हृष्टा युद्धाय तस्थिरे |
verses.iast:
te tu vānara śārdūlāh śārdūlā;iva damṣṭriṇaḥ
gṛhītvā druma śaila agrān hṛṣṭā yuddhāya tasthire |
verses.translation: Those lions among the monkeys, possessing the teeth of tigers, taking hold of trees and rocks, waited delightedly for the signal to fight.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वे विकृत लान्गूलाह् सर्वे दम्ष्ट्रा नख आयुधाः
सर्वे विकृत चित्र अन्गाह् सर्वे च विकृत आननाः |
verses.iast:
sarve vikṛta lāngūlāh sarve damṣṭrā nakha āyudhāḥ
sarve vikṛta citra angāh sarve ca vikṛta ānanāḥ |
verses.translation: All of them were lashing their tails feverishly, using their jaws and nails as weapons, trembling in every limb and had their faces set grimly.

glosses.meaning: using their jaws and nails as weapons

verses.devanagari:
दश नाग बलाह् केचित् केचिद् दश गुण उत्तराः
केचिन् नाग सहस्रस्य बभूवुस् तुल्य विक्रमाः |
verses.iast:
daśa nāga balāh kecit kecid daśa guṇa uttarāḥ
kecin nāga sahasrasya babhūvus tulya vikramāḥ |
verses.translation: Some were having the strength of ten elephants, some a ten times of that and some were equal to the strength of a thousand elephants.

glosses.meaning: having a strength of ten elephants
having a strength of ten times of that
equal to the strength of a thousand elephants.

verses.devanagari:
सन्ति च ओघा बलाह् केचित् केचित् शत गुण उत्तराः
अप्रमेय बलाश् च अन्ये तत्र आसन् हरि यूथपाः |
verses.iast:
santi ca oghā balāh kecit kecit śata guṇa uttarāḥ
aprameya balāś ca anye tatra āsan hari yūthapāḥ |
verses.translation: Some were having the strength of an ogha* of elephants. Some were endowed with a strength of ten times to that. some others there were chiefs of monkeys, having an immeasurable strength.
notes: *For the number represented by on ogha vide canto 28, Sarga 37.

glosses.meaning: having the strength of an ogha* of elephants

verses.devanagari:
अद्भुतश् च विचित्रश् च तेषाम् आसीत् समागमः
तत्र वानर सैन्यानाम् शलभानाम् इव उद्गमः |
verses.iast:
adbhutaś ca vicitraś ca teṣām āsīt samāgamaḥ
tatra vānara sainyānām śalabhānām iva udgamaḥ |
verses.translation: Marvellous and astonishing was the gathering of those troops of monkeys there, like a swarm of locusts.

verses.devanagari:
पतिपूर्णम् इव आकाशम् संचन्ना इव च मेदिनी
लन्काम् उपनिविष्टैश् च सम्पतद्भिश् च वानरैः |
verses.iast:
patipūrṇam iva ākāśam saṃcannā iva ca medinī
lankām upaniviṣṭaiś ca sampatadbhiś ca vānaraiḥ |
verses.translation: By the monkeys who reached Lanka and by those stationed already beneath its walls, the air and earth seem to be completely filled.

glosses.meaning: and by those stationed already beneath its walls

verses.devanagari:
शतम् शत सहस्राणाम् पृथग् ऋक्ष वन ओकसाम्
लन्का द्वाराण्य् उपाजग्मुर् अन्ये योद्धुम् समन्ततः |
verses.iast:
śatam śata sahasrāṇām pṛthag ṛkṣa vana okasām
lankā dvārāṇy upājagmur anye yoddhum samantataḥ |
verses.translation: A hundred divisions of one lakh each of bears and monkeys poured towards the gates of Lanka, while others proceeded to fight on every side.

verses.devanagari:
आवृतह् स गिरिह् सर्वैस् तैह् समन्तात् प्लवम् गमैः
अयुतानाम् सहस्रम् च पुरीम् ताम् अभ्यवर्तत |
verses.iast:
āvṛtah sa girih sarvais taih samantāt plavam gamaiḥ
ayutānām sahasram ca purīm tām abhyavartata |
verses.translation: Those monkeys covered the mountain on every side. A crore of them ranged round that city.

verses.devanagari:
वानरैर् बलवद्भिश् च बभूव द्रुम पाणिभिः
सर्वतह् सम्वृता लन्का दुष्प्रवेशा अपि वायुना |
verses.iast:
vānarair balavadbhiś ca babhūva druma pāṇibhiḥ
sarvatah samvṛtā lankā duṣpraveśā api vāyunā |
verses.translation: Even winds were unable to penetrate Lanka being surrounded on all sides by heroic monkeys holding tree trunks in their hands.

glosses.meaning: holding tree trunks in their hands

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसा विस्मयम् जग्मुह् सहसा अभिनिपीडिताः
वानरैर् मेघ सम्काशैह् शक्र तुल्य पराक्रमैः |
verses.iast:
rākṣasā vismayam jagmuh sahasā abhinipīḍitāḥ
vānarair megha samkāśaih śakra tulya parākramaiḥ |
verses.translation: The demons, who in their valour equaled Indra the ruler of gods, seeing themselves besieged, as by clouds, were struck with sudden terror.

glosses.meaning: who in their valour equaled indra the ruler of gods

verses.devanagari:
महान् शब्दो अभवत् तत्र बल ओघस्य अभिवर्ततः
सागरस्य इव भिन्नस्य यथा स्यात् सलिल स्वनः |
verses.iast:
mahān śabdo abhavat tatra bala oghasya abhivartataḥ
sāgarasya iva bhinnasya yathā syāt salila svanaḥ |
verses.translation: While the flock of monkey- troops was advancing there, a tremendous clamour arose, resembling a roar in the ocean beating against its shore.

verses.devanagari:
तेन शब्देन महता सप्राकारा सतोरणा
लन्का प्रचलिता सर्वा सशैल वन कानना |
verses.iast:
tena śabdena mahatā saprākārā satoraṇā
lankā pracalitā sarvā saśaila vana kānanā |
verses.translation: By that great tumult, the entire Lanka with its ramparts arches, hills, woods and forests began to tremble.

verses.devanagari:
राम लक्ष्मण गुप्ता सा सुग्रीवेण च वाहिनी
बभूव दुर्धर्षतरा सर्वैर् अपि सुर असुरैः |
verses.iast:
rāma lakṣmaṇa guptā sā sugrīveṇa ca vāhinī
babhūva durdharṣatarā sarvair api sura asuraiḥ |
verses.translation: That army of monkeys, guarded by Rama, Lakshmana and Sugreeva became even more invinceible than all the celestials and demons put together.

verses.devanagari:
राघवह् सम्निवेश्य एवम् सैन्यम् स्वम् रक्षसाम् वधे
सम्मन्त्र्य मन्त्रिभिह् सार्धम् निश्चित्य च पुनह् पुनः |
आनन्तर्यम् अभिप्रेप्सुह् क्रम योग अर्थ तत्त्ववित्
विभीषणस्य अनुमते राज धर्मम् अनुस्मरन् |
अन्गदम् वालि तनयम् समाहूय इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
rāghavah samniveśya evam sainyam svam rakṣasām vadhe
sammantrya mantribhih sārdham niścitya ca punah punaḥ |
ānantaryam abhiprepsuh krama yoga artha tattvavit
vibhīṣaṇasya anumate rāja dharmam anusmaran |
angadam vāli tanayam samāhūya idam abravīt
verses.translation: Having thus ranged his forces, with a view to destroy the demons, Rama who knew about the four expedients (to be used against an enemy in the shape of conciliation, gift, sowing dissension and punishment) employed in succession, took counsel again and again with his ministers and arrived at a decision. Calling to his mind the duty of the kings, Rama who was eager to undertake what was to be done next, in concurrence with Vibhishana, summoned Angada the son of Vali and spoke as follows:

glosses.meaning: who knew about four expedients (to be used against an enemy in the shape of conciliation
who was eager to undertake what was to be done next

verses.devanagari:
गत्वा सौम्य दशग्रीवम् ब्रूहि मद् वचनात् कपे |
लन्घयित्वा पुरीम् लन्काम् भयम् त्यक्त्वा गत व्यथः
भ्रष्ट श्रीक गत ऐश्वर्य मुमूर्षो नष्ट चेतनः |
verses.iast:
gatvā saumya daśagrīvam brūhi mad vacanāt kape |
langhayitvā purīm lankām bhayam tyaktvā gata vyathaḥ
bhraṣṭa śrīka gata aiśvarya mumūrṣo naṣṭa cetanaḥ |
verses.translation: "Go my gentle Angada on my behalf and, passing thought the city of Lanka without fear and anxiety and Lanka without fear and anxiety and approaching Ravana - the unfortunate demon devoid of sovereignty and who has lost his splendour because of his inclination to die - admonish him in the following words:"

glosses.meaning: who lost splendour because of his desire for death

verses.devanagari:
ऋषीणाम् देवतानाम् च गन्धर्व अप्सरसाम् तथा
नागानाम् अथ यक्षाणाम् राज्नाम् च रजनी चर |
यच् च पापम् कृतम् मोहाद् अवलिप्तेन राक्षस
नूनम् अद्य गतो दर्पह् स्वयम्भू वर दानजः |
तस्य दण्ड धरस् ते अहम् दार आहरण कर्शितः
verses.iast:
ṛṣīṇām devatānām ca gandharva apsarasām tathā
nāgānām atha yakṣāṇām rājnām ca rajanī cara |
yac ca pāpam kṛtam mohād avaliptena rākṣasa
nūnam adya gato darpah svayambhū vara dānajaḥ |
tasya daṇḍa dharas te aham dāra āharaṇa karśitaḥ
verses.translation: "O, Ravana the Ranger of the Night! In your reckless arrogance, sages, celestials, celestial musicians and their wives, serpent - demons, yakshas the semi-divine beings and kings have been oppressed by you. From now on, that arrogance, born of the boon you received from Brahma the Lord of creation, shall be subdued."

glosses.meaning: to the celestial musicians and their wives
born out of the boon granted to you by Brahma the god of creation

verses.devanagari:
तस्य दण्डधरस्तेऽहम् दाराहरणकर्शितः |
दण्डम् धारयमाणस् तु लन्का द्वरे व्यवस्थितः
verses.iast:
tasya daṇḍadharaste'ham dārāharaṇakarśitaḥ |
daṇḍam dhārayamāṇas tu lankā dvare vyavasthitaḥ
verses.translation: "I shall inflict a fitting penalty for your ruthless abduction of my consort. I am stationed myself at the gate of Lanka, with a Rod of chastisement."

glosses.meaning: having been hurt because of taking away of my wife

verses.devanagari:
पदवीम् देवतानाम् च महर्षीणाम् च राक्षस |
राजर्षीणाम् च सर्वेणाम् गमिष्यसि मया हतः
verses.iast:
padavīm devatānām ca maharṣīṇām ca rākṣasa |
rājarṣīṇām ca sarveṇām gamiṣyasi mayā hataḥ
verses.translation: "O, demon! Slain by me, you will attain the region of Gods, of all the great sages and all the royal sages."

verses.devanagari:
बलेन येन वै सीताम् मायया राक्षस अधम |
माम् अतिक्रामयित्वा त्वम् हृतवांस् तद् विदर्शय
verses.iast:
balena yena vai sītām māyayā rākṣasa adhama |
mām atikrāmayitvā tvam hṛtavāṃs tad vidarśaya
verses.translation: "O, the worst demon! Demonstrate the same courage and magic that you did employ in bearing Seetha away from me."

verses.devanagari:
अराक्षसम् इमम् लोकम् कर्ता अस्मि निशितैह् शरैः |
न चेत् शरणम् अभ्येषि माम् उपादाय मैथिलीम्
verses.iast:
arākṣasam imam lokam kartā asmi niśitaih śaraiḥ |
na cet śaraṇam abhyeṣi mām upādāya maithilīm
verses.translation: "If you do not make an appeal to my clemency by returning Seetha, I shall make this world devoid of all demons."

glosses.meaning: If you do not make an appeal

verses.devanagari:
धर्म आत्मा रक्षसाम् श्रेष्ठह् सम्प्राप्तो अयम् विभीषणः |
लन्का ऐश्वर्यम् ध्रुवम् श्रीमान् अयम् प्राप्नोत्य् अकण्टकम्
verses.iast:
dharma ātmā rakṣasām śreṣṭhah samprāpto ayam vibhīṣaṇaḥ |
lankā aiśvaryam dhruvam śrīmān ayam prāpnoty akaṇṭakam
verses.translation: "This pious minded Vibhishana, the foremost of demons has come to me. Surely, this illustrious demon will obtain the kingdom of Lanka, which will henceforth be free from troubles."

verses.devanagari:
न हि राज्यम् अधर्मेण भोक्तुम् क्षणम् अपि त्वया |
शक्यम् मूर्ख सहायेन पापेन अविजित आत्मना
verses.iast:
na hi rājyam adharmeṇa bhoktum kṣaṇam api tvayā |
śakyam mūrkha sahāyena pāpena avijita ātmanā
verses.translation: "You, without a knowledge of the self and a sinful demon having stupid followers around you, cannot indeed enjoy the kingdom even for a moment, by this unrighteousness."

glosses.meaning: without a knowledge of the self

verses.devanagari:
युध्यस्व वा धृतिम् कृत्वा शौर्यम् आलम्ब्य राक्षस |
मत् शरैस् त्वम् रणे शान्तस् ततह् पूतो भविष्यसि
verses.iast:
yudhyasva vā dhṛtim kṛtvā śauryam ālambya rākṣasa |
mat śarais tvam raṇe śāntas tatah pūto bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: "O, demon! Otherwise, get ready for a battle, by gathering courage and laying hold of your valour. Having been slain by my arrows in combat, you will be laid in peace.

verses.devanagari:
यद्याविशसि लोकांस् त्रीन् पक्षि भूतो मनो जवः |
मम चक्षुष् पथम् प्राप्य न जीवन् प्रतियास्यसि
verses.iast:
yadyāviśasi lokāṃs trīn pakṣi bhūto mano javaḥ |
mama cakṣuṣ patham prāpya na jīvan pratiyāsyasi
verses.translation: "O, Ranger of the Night! Even if you range the three worlds in the forms of a bird, you will not return alive, when you come into my range of sight."

verses.devanagari:
ब्रवीमि त्वाम् हितम् वाक्यम् क्रियताम् और्ध्वदेकिकम् |
सुदृष्टा क्रियताम् लन्का जीवितम् ते मयि स्थितम्
verses.iast:
bravīmi tvām hitam vākyam kriyatām aurdhvadekikam |
sudṛṣṭā kriyatām lankā jīvitam te mayi sthitam
verses.translation: "I give you this salutary counsel prepare for your obsequies. Let Lanka be obliged to be seen well by you (like your last sight), as your survival is in my hands."

verses.devanagari:
इत्य् उक्तह् स तु तारेयो रामेण अक्लिष्ट कर्मणा |
जगाम आकाशम् आविश्य मूर्तिमान् इव हव्य वाट्
verses.iast:
ity uktah sa tu tāreyo rāmeṇa akliṣṭa karmaṇā |
jagāma ākāśam āviśya mūrtimān iva havya vāṭ
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Rama, who was unwearied in action, Angada the son of Tara, leapt into air like a god of fire personified and marched ahead.

verses.devanagari:
सो अतिपत्य मुहूर्तेन श्रीमान् रावण मन्दिरम् |
ददर्श आसीनम् अव्यग्रम् रावणम् सचिवैह् सह
verses.iast:
so atipatya muhūrtena śrīmān rāvaṇa mandiram |
dadarśa āsīnam avyagram rāvaṇam sacivaih saha
verses.translation: Reaching Ravana's palace in an instant, the illustrious Angada saw Ravana, seated coolly along with his ministers.

verses.devanagari:
ततस् तस्य अविदूरेण निपत्य हरि पुम्गवः |
दीप्त अग्नि सदृशस् तस्थाव् अन्गदह् कनक अन्गदः
verses.iast:
tatas tasya avidūreṇa nipatya hari pumgavaḥ |
dīpta agni sadṛśas tasthāv angadah kanaka angadaḥ
verses.translation: Angada, the foremost of the monkeys, wearing golden bracelets, descended close to the king and stood there like a flaming torch.

verses.devanagari:
तद् राम वचनम् सर्वम् अन्यून अधिकम् उत्तमम् |
सामात्यम् श्रावयाम् आस निवेद्य आत्मानम् आत्मना
verses.iast:
tad rāma vacanam sarvam anyūna adhikam uttamam |
sāmātyam śrāvayām āsa nivedya ātmānam ātmanā
verses.translation: Having made himself known, Angada communicated, that whole of the excellent speech of Rama without adding or subtracting anything to Ravana in the presence of Ravana's ministers, saying:

glosses.meaning: to Ravana in the presence of his ministers (a follows):

verses.devanagari:
दूतो अहम् कोसल इन्द्रस्य रामस्य अक्लिष्ट कर्मणः |
वालि पुत्रो अन्गदो नाम यदि ते श्रोत्रम् आगतः
verses.iast:
dūto aham kosala indrasya rāmasya akliṣṭa karmaṇaḥ |
vāli putro angado nāma yadi te śrotram āgataḥ
verses.translation: "I am the son of Vali, Angada by name. I have come as a messenger for the king of Koshala, Rama of imperishable exploits. Has my name ever reached your ears?"

verses.devanagari:
आह त्वाम् राघवो रामह् कौसल्य आनन्द वर्धनः |
निष्पत्य प्रतियुध्यस्व नृशंसम् पुरुष अधम
verses.iast:
āha tvām rāghavo rāmah kausalya ānanda vardhanaḥ |
niṣpatya pratiyudhyasva nṛśaṃsam puruṣa adhama
verses.translation: "Rama who is born in Raghu dynasty and who augements the joy of Kausalya speaks thus to you, �O, ruthless demon! Come forth and enter into combat. Prove to be the representative of your race!' "

glosses.meaning: who augments the joy of Kausalya
and the one born in Raghu dynasty
to be the representative of your race.

verses.devanagari:
हन्ता अस्मि त्वाम् सह अमात्यम् सपुत्र ज्नाति बान्धवम् |
निरुद्विग्नास् त्रयो लोका भविष्यन्ति हते त्वयि
verses.iast:
hantā asmi tvām saha amātyam saputra jnāti bāndhavam |
nirudvignās trayo lokā bhaviṣyanti hate tvayi
verses.translation: " �I shall kill you along with your ministers, sons, cousins and other relatives. You being dead, all the three worlds will be rid of fear.'"

verses.devanagari:
देव दानव यक्षाणाम् गन्धर्व उरग रक्षसाम् |
शत्रुम् अद्य उद्धरिष्यामि त्वाम् ऋषीणाम् च कण्टकम्
verses.iast:
deva dānava yakṣāṇām gandharva uraga rakṣasām |
śatrum adya uddhariṣyāmi tvām ṛṣīṇām ca kaṇṭakam
verses.translation: " �Now, I shall uproot you, a thorn to sages and an enemy to celestials, demons, semi-divine beings, celestial musicians, serpent-gods and ogres'."

verses.devanagari:
विभीषणस्य च ऐश्वर्यम् भविष्यति हते त्वयि |
न चेत् सत्कृत्य वैदेहीम् प्रणिपत्य प्रदास्यसि
verses.iast:
vibhīṣaṇasya ca aiśvaryam bhaviṣyati hate tvayi |
na cet satkṛtya vaidehīm praṇipatya pradāsyasi
verses.translation: "If you do not restore Seetha honourably, by bowing respectfully before me, you are slain and Vibhishana will become the king.'"

verses.devanagari:
इत्य् एवम् परुषम् वाक्यम् ब्रुवाणे हरि पुम्गवे |
अमर्ष वशम् आपन्नो निशा चर गण ईश्वरः
verses.iast:
ity evam paruṣam vākyam bruvāṇe hari pumgave |
amarṣa vaśam āpanno niśā cara gaṇa īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: Hearing these harsh words from Angada the lion among the monkeys, Ravana the Lord of the demon-tribe was infuriated.

glosses.meaning: Ravana the Lord of the demon-tribe

verses.devanagari:
ततः स रोष ताम्र अक्षह् शशास सचिवांस् तदा |
गृह्यताम् एष दुर्मेधा वध्यताम् इति च असकृत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa roṣa tāmra akṣah śaśāsa sacivāṃs tadā |
gṛhyatām eṣa durmedhā vadhyatām iti ca asakṛt
verses.translation: Then, the enraged Ravana repeatedly commanded his attendants, saying: "Let this stupid monkey be seized and put to death."

verses.devanagari:
रावणस्य वचह् श्रुत्वा दीप्त अग्नि सम तेजसः |
जगृहुस् तम् ततो घोराश् चत्वारो रजनी चराः
verses.iast:
rāvaṇasya vacah śrutvā dīpta agni sama tejasaḥ |
jagṛhus tam tato ghorāś catvāro rajanī carāḥ
verses.translation: Hearing Ravana's words, four terrible demons seized Angada who, in his splendour, resembled a blazing torch.

verses.devanagari:
ग्राहयाम् आस तारेयह् स्वयम् आत्मानम् आत्मना |
बलम् दर्शयितुम् वीरो यातु धान गणे तदा
verses.iast:
grāhayām āsa tāreyah svayam ātmānam ātmanā |
balam darśayitum vīro yātu dhāna gaṇe tadā
verses.translation: Then, the prudent and heroic Angada the son of Tara voluntarily allowed himself to be seized, in order to display his prowess before the host of demons.

verses.devanagari:
स तान् बाहु द्वये सक्तान् आदाय पतगान् इव |
प्रासादम् शैल सम्काशम् उत्पापात अन्गदस् तदा
verses.iast:
sa tān bāhu dvaye saktān ādāya patagān iva |
prāsādam śaila samkāśam utpāpāta angadas tadā
verses.translation: Then, seizing like unto birds those attendants clung to his arms, Angada leapt on to the palace that resembled like a mountain.

glosses.meaning: saktaan = entangled in both of his arms

verses.devanagari:
तेस्योत्पतनवेगेन निर्धूतास्तत्र राक्षसाः |
भुमौ निपतिताह् सर्वे राक्षस इन्द्रस्य पश्यतः
verses.iast:
tesyotpatanavegena nirdhūtāstatra rākṣasāḥ |
bhumau nipatitāh sarve rākṣasa indrasya paśyataḥ
verses.translation: All those four demons were shaken out by Angada's impetuous leap and fell on the ground there under the eyes of their king.

glosses.meaning: by Angada's utpatana vegena = impetuous leap

verses.devanagari:
ततः प्रासाद शिखरम् शैल शृन्गम् इव उन्नतम् |
तत् पफाल तदा आक्रान्तम् दशग्रीवस्य पश्यतः
verses.iast:
tataḥ prāsāda śikharam śaila śṛngam iva unnatam |
tat paphāla tadā ākrāntam daśagrīvasya paśyataḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter, the glorious Angada the son of Vali ascended the roof of Ravana's palace, which equaled the summit of a mountain in height.

glosses.meaning: which equaled the summit of a mountain

verses.devanagari:
पफाल च तदाक्रान्तं दशग्रीवस्य पश्यतः |
पुरा हिमवतः शृङ्गं वज्रेणेव विदारितम्
verses.iast:
paphāla ca tadākrāntaṃ daśagrīvasya paśyataḥ |
purā himavataḥ śṛṇ^gaṃ vajreṇeva vidāritam
verses.translation: That roof of the palace, trampled by Angada, crumbled - as a peak of Himalayan range was shattered long ago by lightening - before Ravana's gaze.

glosses.meaning: as a peak of Himalayan range

verses.devanagari:
भन्क्त्वा प्रासाद शिखरम् नाम विश्राव्य च आत्मनः |
विनद्य सुमहा नादम् उत्पपात विहायसा
verses.iast:
bhanktvā prāsāda śikharam nāma viśrāvya ca ātmanaḥ |
vinadya sumahā nādam utpapāta vihāyasā
verses.translation: After destroying the roof of the palace, Angada proclaimed his name and with a triumphant roar, rose into the air.

verses.devanagari:
व्यथयन् राक्षसान् सर्वान् हर्षयंश्चापि वानरान् |
स वानराणां मध्ये तु रामपार्श्वमुपागतः
verses.iast:
vyathayan rākṣasān sarvān harṣayaṃścāpi vānarān |
sa vānarāṇāṃ madhye tu rāmapārśvamupāgataḥ
verses.translation: Causing restlessness to all the demons but delight to the monkeys, Angada approached close to Rama, who was stationed in the middle of the monkey-forces.

verses.devanagari:
रावणस् तु परम् चक्रे क्रोधम् प्रासाद धर्षणात् |
विनाशम् च आत्मनह् पश्यन् निह्श्वास परमो अभवत्
verses.iast:
rāvaṇas tu param cakre krodham prāsāda dharṣaṇāt |
vināśam ca ātmanah paśyan nihśvāsa paramo abhavat
verses.translation: Because of the destruction of his palace, Ravana on his part got extremely angry. Foreseeing his own destruction, he became a desponded demon.

glosses.meaning: because of the destruction of the palace

verses.devanagari:
रामस् तु बहुभिर् हृष्टैर् निनदद्भिह् प्लवम् गमैः |
वृतो रिपु वध आकान्क्षी युद्धाय एव अभ्यवर्तत
verses.iast:
rāmas tu bahubhir hṛṣṭair ninadadbhih plavam gamaiḥ |
vṛto ripu vadha ākānkṣī yuddhāya eva abhyavartata
verses.translation: Surrounded by many monkeys, roaring with delight, Rama on his part was proceeding ahead already for the battle, with an intent to wipe out the enemy.

glosses.meaning: with an intent to wipe out the enemy.

verses.devanagari:
सुषेणस् तु महा वीर्यो गिरि कूट उपमो हरिः |
बहुभिह् सम्वृतस् तत्र वानरैह् काम रूपिभिः
verses.iast:
suṣeṇas tu mahā vīryo giri kūṭa upamo hariḥ |
bahubhih samvṛtas tatra vānaraih kāma rūpibhiḥ
verses.translation: Now, Sushena the highly valiant monkey, was stationed there like the head of the mountain surrounded by innumerable monkeys, who were bale to change their form at will.

glosses.meaning: girikuuTopamaH = was like the head of the mountain
who were able to change their form at will.

verses.devanagari:
स तु द्वाराणि सर्वाणि सुग्रीव वचनात् कपिः |
पर्याक्रमत दुर्धर्षो नक्षत्राणि इव चन्द्रमाः
verses.iast:
sa tu dvārāṇi sarvāṇi sugrīva vacanāt kapiḥ |
paryākramata durdharṣo nakṣatrāṇi iva candramāḥ
verses.translation: Under the order of Sugreeva, the invincible monkey, Sushena was patrolling the gates and wandering like a moon among the stars.

verses.devanagari:
तेषाम् अक्षौहिणि शतम् समवेक्ष्य वन ओकसाम् |
लन्काम् उपनिविष्टानाम् सागरम् च अतिवर्तताम्
राक्षसा विस्मयम् जग्मुस् त्रासम् जग्मुस् तथा अपरे |
अपरे समर उद्धर्षाद्द् हर्षम् एव उपपेदिरे
verses.iast:
teṣām akṣauhiṇi śatam samavekṣya vana okasām |
lankām upaniviṣṭānām sāgaram ca ativartatām
rākṣasā vismayam jagmus trāsam jagmus tathā apare |
apare samara uddharṣādd harṣam eva upapedire
verses.translation: Seeing hundreds of divisions of those monkeys encamped under the walls of Lanka, marshaled on the shores of the sea, the demons were amazed and some others were terror-struck while others, overjoyed at the prospect of fighting, leapt even in exultation.

glosses.meaning: (marshaled on the shores) of the sea

verses.devanagari:
कृत्स्नम् हि कपिभिर् व्याप्तम् प्राकार परिख अन्तरम् |
ददृशू राक्षसा दीनाह् प्राकारम् वानरी कृतम्
हाहाकारमकुर्वन्त राक्षसा भयमागताः |
verses.iast:
kṛtsnam hi kapibhir vyāptam prākāra parikha antaram |
dadṛśū rākṣasā dīnāh prākāram vānarī kṛtam
hāhākāramakurvanta rākṣasā bhayamāgatāḥ |
verses.translation: Those miserable demons saw the entire extensive space between the walls and the moat being occupied by the monkeys, like unto a second rampart. The demons cried out, "Woe! Alas!" in panic.

glosses.meaning: space between the walls and the moat
like under unto a second rampart

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन् महा भीषणके प्रवृत्ते |
कोलाहले राक्षस राजधान्याम् |
प्रगृह्य रक्षांसि महा आयुधानि |
युग अन्त वाता;इव सम्विचेरुह्
verses.iast:
tasmin mahā bhīṣaṇake pravṛtte |
kolāhale rākṣasa rājadhānyām |
pragṛhya rakṣāṃsi mahā āyudhāni |
yuga anta vātā;iva samviceruh
verses.translation: As a result of that appalling tumult in the capital city of the demons, the soldiers of Ravana seized hold of their great weapons and sallied forth like the winds that blow at the dissolution of the worlds.

glosses.meaning: in the capital city of demons
like the winds that blow at the dissolution of the worlds.
